title: 99% Of Exported Bananas Are The Same Clone
hook: 99% of exported bananas share one Cavendish weakness.
closing: If the Cavendish falls, cheap bananas could vanish before another variety replaces it.
question: Have you tried another banana?

segments.say: Cavendish makes up 99 percent of exported bananas. Buying one almost anywhere means eating essentially the same clone.
More than 1,000 banana varieties exist, yet only one dominates exports. The global supply has almost no backup.
The fungus reached three continents, up from one in 1990. Identical plants share one weakness, so disease spreads freely.
